comparison_to_v1_10.interpretation: Street View changed the coverage-accuracy tradeoff; this is a version comparison, not same-configuration repeatability.

confidence_method.definition: estimated probability that the recorded field value is correct
confidence_method.estimator: observed answered accuracy pooled within each frozen pipeline risk stratum and rounded to two decimals
confidence_method.same_sample_limitation: Confidence is descriptive in-sample reliability from these 25 schools, not externally validated calibration.

limitations: This is an in-project descriptive check against prior reviewed measurements, not an independent external validation set.
The 225 field-school cells are clustered within 25 schools and are not independent.
Confidence uses the same small 25-school project sample and therefore is descriptive, not an independent calibration guarantee.
Rows remain unreviewed or needs-review; model outputs do not become human-reviewed labels automatically.
